Adds eight to each entry in two 256-byte tables at $9000 and $1CC4, banks out BASIC and KERNAL, selects the VIC bank at $4000, and installs the hardware interrupt vectors before entering the title flow.
Disables sprites, invokes the title and high-score sequence, sets the gameplay IRQ vector, clears working state and starts with three retries and train number one.
Selects the train script from the train number and saves the supply state used by the retry path.
Clears frame state, keeps the starting train for retry, builds the opening screen and entity state, then enables interrupts and presents the start prompt before taking control input.
Calls the song setup with A=$00 and X=$A7, then enables the music driver with $A000=1.

Runs the scenery and entity work, samples controls and updates the HUD. Checks the failure state and calls the train transition path before the next tick.

Clears the active-race flag and display. A nonzero retry count is debited at $1171, then the retry path scans back in the script for the $8 checkpoint tag. A zero count branches to the title.

Preserves A, X and Y, advances a six-slot index, and writes the selected fine-scroll, raster compare, screen and character pointer, and colour values. The branch at $1278 goes to the once-per-frame playfield path for slot four. Live checkpoints measured six entries and one slot-four path per frame.
Signals the raster boundary and, when play is active, updates sprite state and collects the VIC sprite collision mask before running the collision and projectile paths.
Adjusts the playfield scroll phases and the staged actor coordinates when the active raster slot permits the next simulation update.
Applies staged X and Y coordinates, X high bits, image pointers, visibility, expansion and colours to the VIC. Sprite two can take its position and image from a distinct path.
On split one, moves sprites zero and one vertically during transition modes two and four. Then restores Y, X and A and returns from the interrupt.
Six raster compare lines, indexed by the slot selected at $1229.

For object state $11, moves the slot eight pixels horizontally, updates its high X bit and advances a wrapped forty-column coordinate before testing the contact class in $9100. State $2B moves vertically upward instead and expires above the threshold.

ANDs CIA1 A and B, inverts the five joystick bits and stores them at $30. With both sticks neutral, rotates an active-low select through CIA1 A and folds keyboard codes into $30 from sampled CIA1 B bits. Both joystick ports and the keyboard path were checked with instruction stops.
